expertText:
* = $1500
OldDD00:
.byte 0
OldD018:
.byte 0
OldD016:
.byte 0
OldD011:
.byte 0
.macro BitmapOn
    SEI
    LDA $DD00
    STA OldDD00
    LDA $D018
    STA OldD018
    LDA $D016
    STA OldD016
    LDA $D011
    STA OldD011
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #%00000011
    STA $DD00
    LDA #$18
    STA $D018
    LDA $D016
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D016
    LDA $D011
    ORA #%00100000
    STA $D011
    JSR HiresClearScreen
    JSR ClearColorRam
    CLI
.endm
.macro BitmapOff
    SEI
    LDA OldD016
    STA $D016
    LDA OldD018
    STA $D018
    LDA OldDD00
    STA $DD00
    LDA OldD011
    STA $D011
    CLI
    LDA #$93
    JSR $FFD2
.endm
.macro HiresClearScreen
    LDX #$20
    LDY #$00
    LDA #$00
    STA $FB
    LDA #$20
    STA $FC
    LDA #$00
HcsBmpPage:
    STA ($FB),Y
    INY
    BNE HcsBmpPage
    INC $FC
    DEX
    BNE HcsBmpPage
    LDA #$00
    LDX #$00
HcsScreenBlock:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE HcsScreenBlock
    LDX #$00
HcsScreenTail:
    CPX #$E8
    BEQ HcsDone
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    BNE HcsScreenTail
HcsDone:
.endm
.macro ClearColorRam
    LDA #$00
    LDX #$00
CcrBlock:
    STA $D800,X
    STA $D900,X
    STA $DA00,X
    INX
    BNE CcrBlock
    LDX #$00
CcrTail:
    CPX #$E8
    BEQ CcrDone
    STA $DB00,X
    INX
    BNE CcrTail
CcrDone:
.endm
.macro WaitForKey
    CLI
WaitKeyLoop:
    JSR $FFE4
    BEQ WaitKeyLoop
    SEI
.endm
.macro DbufSetup
    ; Double-buffer init. Call once before main loop.
    ; ZP $10 (draw_bmp_hi): $20=bank0 bitmap, $60=bank1 bitmap
    ; ZP $11 (dbuf_bank):   $03=bank0, $02=bank1 for DD00 bits 0-1
    ; On return: VIC shows bank0, draw target = bank1.
    LDA #$60
    STA $10
    LDA #$02
    STA $11
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #$03
    STA $DD00
    LDA #$10
    LDX #$00
DbufFillB1:
    STA $4400,X
    STA $4500,X
    STA $4600,X
    INX
    BNE DbufFillB1
    LDX #$00
DbufFillB2:
    STA $4700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE DbufFillB2
.endm
.macro DbufSwap
    ; Wait for vblank then swap display/draw buffers.
    ; Call after a complete frame is drawn.
DbufW1:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCC DbufW1
DbufW2:
    LDA $D012
    CMP #$F8
    BCS DbufW2
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA $11
    STA $DD00
    LDA $11
    EOR #$01
    STA $11
    LDA $10
    EOR #$40
    STA $10
.endm
; ---- Hires graphics library (double-buffer aware) ----
clear_bitmap:
    LDA $10
    STA $FE
    LDA #$00
    STA $FD
    LDX #$1F
    LDY #$00
cb_page:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    BNE cb_page
    INC $FE
    DEX
    BNE cb_page
    LDY #$00
cb_tail:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    CPY #$40
    BNE cb_tail
    RTS

setpixel:
; In: $FB=X lo, $FC=Y (0-199), $2E=cx_hi (0 or 1 for X 0..319)
    TXA
    PHA
    LDA $FC
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    TAX
    LDA row320lo,X
    STA $FD
    LDA row320hi,X
    STA $FE
    LDA $FB
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    STA $05
    LDA $2E
    BEQ sp_xbyte_ok
    LDA $05
    CLC
    ADC #$20
    STA $05
sp_xbyte_ok:
    LDA #$00
    STA $06
    LDA $05
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    LDA $06
    ADC $FE
    STA $FE
    CLC
    LDA $FE
    ADC $10
    STA $FE
    LDA $FC
    AND #$07
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    BCC sp_ok
    INC $FE
sp_ok:
    LDA $FB
    AND #$07
    TAX
    LDA bitmask,X
    LDY #$00
    ORA ($FD),Y
    STA ($FD),Y
    PLA
    TAX
    RTS

draw_line:
; In: $20=X0lo, $2C=X0hi, $21=Y0, $22=X1lo, $2D=X1hi, $23=Y1
; 16-bit err Bresenham. Full 0..319 X, 0..199 Y.
    LDA $20
    STA $FB
    LDA $2C
    STA $2E
    LDA $21
    STA $FC
    LDA $2D
    CMP $2C
    BCC dl_xneg
    BNE dl_xpos
    LDA $22
    CMP $20
    BCC dl_xneg
dl_xpos:
    SEC
    LDA $22
    SBC $20
    STA $24
    LDA $2D
    SBC $2C
    STA $2F
    LDA #$01
    STA $26
    JMP dl_caldy
dl_xneg:
    SEC
    LDA $20
    SBC $22
    STA $24
    LDA $2C
    SBC $2D
    STA $2F
    LDA #$FF
    STA $26
dl_caldy:
    LDA $23
    CMP $21
    BCS dl_ypos
    SEC
    LDA $21
    SBC $23
    STA $25
    LDA #$FF
    STA $27
    JMP dl_init
dl_ypos:
    SEC
    LDA $23
    SBC $21
    STA $25
    LDA #$01
    STA $27
dl_init:
    SEC
    LDA $24
    SBC $25
    STA $28
    LDA $2F
    SBC #$00
    STA $29
dl_loop:
    JSR setpixel
    LDA $FB
    CMP $22
    BNE dl_step
    LDA $2E
    CMP $2D
    BNE dl_step
    LDA $FC
    CMP $23
    BEQ dl_done
dl_step:
    LDA $28
    ASL
    STA $05
    LDA $29
    ROL
    STA $06
    CLC
    LDA $05
    ADC $25
    TAX
    LDA $06
    ADC #$00
    BPL dl_xchk
    JMP dl_ychk
dl_xchk:
    BNE dl_do_x
    CPX #$00
    BEQ dl_ychk
dl_do_x:
    SEC
    LDA $28
    SBC $25
    STA $28
    LDA $29
    SBC #$00
    STA $29
    LDA $26
    BMI dl_dec_x
dl_inc_x:
    INC $FB
    BNE dl_ychk
    INC $2E
    JMP dl_ychk
dl_dec_x:
    LDA $FB
    BNE dl_dec_x_lo
    DEC $2E
dl_dec_x_lo:
    DEC $FB
dl_ychk:
    LDA $06
    BMI dl_do_y
    CMP $2F
    BCC dl_do_y
    BNE dl_loop
    LDA $05
    CMP $24
    BCC dl_do_y
    JMP dl_loop
dl_do_y:
    CLC
    LDA $28
    ADC $24
    STA $28
    LDA $29
    ADC $2F
    STA $29
    CLC
    LDA $FC
    ADC $27
    STA $FC
    JMP dl_loop
dl_done:
    RTS

row320lo:
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00,$40,$80,$C0,$00,$40,$80,$C0
.byte $00

row320hi:
.byte $00,$01,$02,$03,$05,$06,$07,$08
.byte $0A,$0B,$0C,$0D,$0F,$10,$11,$12
.byte $14,$15,$16,$17,$19,$1A,$1B,$1C
.byte $1E

bitmask:
.byte $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01
.macro DisplayOff
    LDA $D011
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D011
.endm
.macro DisplayOn
    LDA $D011
    ORA #%00010000
    STA $D011
.endm
; ---- Convenience macros (wrap library subroutines) ----
.macro ClearBitmap
    JSR clear_bitmap
.endm
.macro PlotPixel x, y
    ; x is a word (0..319), y a byte (0..199)
    LDA #<{x}
    STA $FB
    LDA #>{x}
    STA $2E
    LDA #<{y}
    STA $FC
    JSR setpixel
.endm
.macro DrawLine x0, y0, x1, y1
    ; x0/x1 are words (0..319), y0/y1 bytes (0..199)
    LDA #<{x0}
    STA $20
    LDA #>{x0}
    STA $2C
    LDA #<{y0}
    STA $21
    LDA #<{x1}
    STA $22
    LDA #>{x1}
    STA $2D
    LDA #<{y1}
    STA $23
    JSR draw_line
.endm
.macro SetColor fg, bg
    ; Fill screen RAM ($0400-$07E7) with (fg<<4)|bg — hires foreground/background per 8x8 cell
    LDA #{fg}
    ASL
    ASL
    ASL
    ASL
    ORA #{bg}
    LDX #$00
SetColorLoop:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE SetColorLoop
    LDX #$00
SetColorTail:
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE SetColorTail
.endm
